what: The terminal shows the command `node argv_peek.js --seat 12A Ada Lovelace` with no quotes, but the output has 'Ada Lovelace' as one argument, and the prose says quotes keep it together. fix: In capture.py, build the shown command with shlex.quote for each argument (" ".join(shlex.quote(x) for x in a)) and recapture js 27, so the terminal shows `node argv_peek.js --seat 12A 'Ada Lovelace'`. P3 also says "exit 0 means the whole run was green, which is what build servers check", but a reader who copies `node --test | sed …` into CI gets 0 on failure. Known class: INTEGRATION_TODO 'HIDDEN `exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}`' (go only so far). js ch26 has the same hidden suffix in 8 npm/esbuild steps (bundle, market_*), but all of those exit 0, so nothing visible changes there.
